title: Morocco is underrated 🇲🇦 #morocco #marrakech #travel
description:
Morocco is completely underrated and everyone needs to go NOW 🇲🇦✈️

Here's why: the Medina of Marrakech is absolutely insane. We got lost for hours in the souks and it was the best thing that happened to us. Jemaa el-Fna square at night with all the food stalls is a must. Day trip to the Sahara Desert from Marrakech took 9 hours but seeing the dunes was bucket list stuff. The blue streets of Chefchaouen are even more beautiful in person. And the food — tagine every single day, no complaints.

#morocco #marrakech #sahara #chefchaouen #africa #traveltiktok #travelwithme #hidden gems
